err.steam_id_invalid_link:
Accepted formats:
• Custom URL: `https://steamcommunity.com/id/yuminiteru/`
• Numeric URL: `https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198xxxxxxxxx`
• Custom name only: `yuminiteru`
• SteamID64 only: `76561198xxxxxxxxx` (17 digits)

inventory.unavailable_desc:
The CS2 inventory of **{name}** is not publicly accessible.

**Go to** https://steamcommunity.com/my/edit/settings **and set these 3 settings to `Public`:**
1️⃣ **My profile**
2️⃣ **Game details** *(often missed — required for CS2!)*
3️⃣ **Inventory**

Other possible causes: Steam rate-limit (retry in 2-5 min) or a VAC/trade ban.

_Direct test: https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/{steam_id}/inventory/#730_
